name: @pipeworx/mcp-waqi

tools.name: get_aqi_by_city
tools.description: Latest AQI for a city from the World Air Quality Index Project station network. Accepts "city" or "city, country" (e.g. "Rome, Italy"). The matched station is checked against the requested place: a station that is not plausibly in it (the upstream resolves "Venice" to Dayton, Ohio) is never served; the call errors naming what it matched and listing candidates, and the response carries a place block stating requested vs matched. Every reading carries measured_at, station identity, data_age_hours and freshness. A reading older than 24h is never returned as current: a reporting station within 100 km is used (station_selection=fallback_fresher_station; skipped_stale_station says what was passed over) or the call errors naming the station and its age. Returns AQI value, dominant pollutant, individual pollutant readings (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO), temperature/humidity/pressure, and station info.

city.description: City name, optionally qualified by country or region after a comma (e.g., "beijing", "los-angeles", "Rome, Italy", "Paris, Texas")

tools.name: get_aqi_by_location
tools.description: Latest AQI for the WAQI station nearest a lat/lon. Carries measured_at, data_age_hours and freshness; a station silent for over 24h is replaced by a reporting one within 100 km or the call errors.

tools.name: get_aqi_by_station
tools.description: Latest AQI for a specific WAQI station by UID (numeric). Returned as asked even if the station has gone quiet, so check freshness and data_age_hours (stale = over 24h).

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search stations by keyword (city/region name). Returns station UID, name, current AQI, and location.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-waqi forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the waqi pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
